title.value: A POMDP Model for Safe Geological Carbon Sequestration
title.justification: The paper explicitly discusses a POMDP (Partially Observable Markov Decision Process) model in the context of geological carbon sequestration, as seen in the introduction and highlighted throughout the paper.
title.quote: Geological carbon capture and sequestration (CCS), where CO2 is stored in subsurface formations, is a promising and scalable approach for reducing global emissions...these risks are exacerbated by the large amount of uncertainty in the structure of the storage formation...we propose that CCS operations be modeled as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP).

extractions.description: This paper presents a POMDP model for managing geological carbon sequestration (CCS), focusing on safe storage of CO2 in subsurface formations. It addresses uncertainties in storage formation structure that pose environmental risks. By employing POMDP solvers, the paper compares the performance of these solving techniques against expert baselines, demonstrating improvements in safety and efficiency in CCS operations.
